what_changed: The source-collector agent now reliably emits canonical `{"prs":[...],"jira_issues":[...]}` JSON on Mode B runs. Four confirmed root causes were closed: (1) the global stop-verify hook was contaminating child-process stdout with a verification preamble that broke `json.loads` — fixed by passing `CLAUDE_STOP_VERIFY=0` in the `dispatch_subagent` subprocess env; (2) the agent was reflexively emitting status-report objects (`{"status":"idle",...}`) instead of data — fixed by adding a `## Forbidden outputs` subsection to `agents/source-collector.md` with concrete bad-shape examples; (3) the field name `issues` (and variants) was being used instead of the required `jira_issues` key — the forbidden-outputs section now names `jira_issues` as the only valid key; (4) a meta-refusal regression where the agent reframed the embedded payload as untrusted and declined to act — a fourth forbidden-outputs entry explicitly prohibits refusal, deferral, and clarification-request responses. A redundant legacy `## Output contract` block was also removed from the agent prompt. Validation: 5/5 consecutive Mode B runs against the CCE-11 self-host harness emit canonical-shape JSON, up from 0/5 pre-fix.
why: CCE-9 and CCE-11 diagnostic evidence showed the source-collector was failing schema validation in every captured Mode B run, blocking all downstream pipeline stages (spec-extractor, page-author, lint-runner, etc.). The root causes were environmental (the stop-verify hook firing inside the child Claude session), agent-instruction gaps (no explicit prohibition of status-report or refusal shapes), and a field-naming ambiguity that the agent resolved incorrectly. CCE-10 was filed to close all confirmed root causes so CCE-12 (tool-use / content-yield diagnostics) could proceed on a stable foundation.
notes: Content yield remains low — 4 of 5 validation runs returned empty arrays; only Run 5 picked up 3 jira_issues. The canonical shape is now stable, but the agent is not consistently invoking `gh pr list` against the diff window. This F2 failure mode is the subject of CCE-12 and is explicitly out of scope for this PR. No Jira context was provided in inputs; rationale is drawn entirely from the PR body and referenced measurement documents.
